A0202.title: SBOM Generation and Vulnerability Impact Analysis
A0202.description: Generates SBOMs for applications, images, and firmware by collecting dependency component inventories, and employs version matching, vulnerability intelligence comparison, and baseline verification to locate affected assets by component sequence and assess impact scope when new vulnerabilities are disclosed.

references.title: 2025 Minimum Elements for a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) - CISA

keywords: SBOM Generation and Vulnerability Impact Analysis
A0202.definition: Generate SBOMs for applications, images, and firmware, and quickly locate affected assets when new vulnerabilities are disclosed.
A0202.limitation: SBOMs are prone to omitting transitive dependencies and nested components; attackers may bypass inventory matching through obfuscated package names or private patches. Intelligence lag leads to false negatives, while normal multi-version coexistence and dynamic-link library loading tend to produce false positive noise, reducing asset location accuracy.
